title: Stars come out to support RBC Training Ground in 2019
description: Established Olympians like Patrick Chan and Aaron Brown took to social media to talk about the RBC Training Ground program and how it's poised to uncover the next household Canadian name. asr.full_text: THE WORD IS OUT ABOUT RBC TRAINING GROUND, SEPTEMBER 4TH. COURTNEY CHENARIO, When an outside partner like RBC comes in and they're like, yo, we see potential in this kid. How did that change your outlook? JOEL MOLITO, When you have someone else support you, it kind of gives you that inspiration to be like, maybe they're right, maybe I can do it. TAMRA ROUDER, How jealous are you of all these? across the country across platforms and around the world rbc and some of Canada's top athletes are talking about training ground helping spread the word about Canada's most effective athlete selection and high performance development program one of the fastest men in the world Aaron Brown. Aaron, what's up my guy? Not much, man. What's up? Tokyo 2020, what's your goal? Gonna meddle for sure. Piers Lapage and others showing world-class promise have taken advantage of RVC support to push themselves farther than they could have ever dreamed. In the new year, you're going to do Canadian Champs. That's pretty crazy for Year One, but all right. First off, Canadian Nationals. Next stop, Olympics. Since 2016, RBC has invested more than a million dollars in the next generation of Canadian Olympians and this year there is a new twist to Training Ground. Thirty-four regional testing events, eight national sports organizations, and a hundred athletes invited to a national final in September. It is potentially Canada's greatest collection of untapped talent in amateur sports history, each with a chance to turn their dreams into Olympic reality. Could it be you? Register now! RBCTraininginingground.ca

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it promotes and explains RBC Training Ground as an athletic testing and development program, showing sports participants and assessments rather than a financial or investment offer. The “Register now” prompt is tied to entering the described athletic program, and the available material describes ordinary sports-program promotion without a payment requirement, investment return, credential request, or other deceptive participation mechanism. Promotional claims about funding, athlete selection, and Olympic opportunities do not change that described context.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary context is general sports and athlete-development content: the source describes athlete selection, high-performance development and testing events, while the frames show athletes performing physical assessments.
